services.name: 15% Off All Services
services.description: Take 15% off all services through Columbus Day, Monday, October 12. Excludes nail and eyebrow services.
services.fullDescription:
For Columbus Day, all services at Laura's Beauty Touch are 15% off through Monday, October 12.

That includes facials, laser hair removal, waxing, lashes, body treatments and makeup.

Not included: nail services and eyebrow services.

Discount is applied at checkout and cannot be combined with other offers. Holiday weekend slots go quickly, so book early.
